rows.kind: defaults override the caller and mutate
rows.summary: withDefaults currently mutates the caller's object and lets DEFAULTS overwrite caller-supplied values. It now builds a new object with the defaults as the base and the caller's options spread on top, so caller values win and the input is untouched.
Memoize on all arguments instead of only the first, so a different second argument produces a different cache entry rather than a stale answer.
loadAll maps over ids and returns the array of promises; awaiting Promise.all makes it resolve to the list of results instead of Promise objects.
Require a dot in the domain part of the email: the domain must contain at least one dot separating non-empty labels, so 'a@b' is rejected while 'a@b.co' and 'x.y@mail.example.org' still pass.
Rename fetchUser to getUser in apps/web/src/users.js (definition and export) and in apps/web/src/greeting.js (import and call site).
Make Lru.get() refresh recency: on a hit, delete and re-insert the key so it moves to the most-recently-used end of the Map, preventing a just-read entry from being the one evicted.
Fix formatDuration so minutes and seconds are the remainders after removing hours and minutes (3725 -> '1h 2m 5s') instead of the raw cumulative totals.
Make parseAge throw a RangeError with 'invalid age' in the message for non-numeric, negative, over-150 and empty input, while returning the number for valid ages.
Fix subtotal to multiply each line's price by its quantity, so buying an item more than once is charged correctly.
Make removeAt non-mutating by copying the input list before splicing, so the caller's array is left unchanged.
Fix 1-based pagination: page 1 must start at offset 0, so compute the start index as (page - 1) * size instead of page * size.

rows.kind: defaults override the caller and mutate
rows.summary: withDefaults now returns a new object where DEFAULTS are applied first and the caller's values win, so caller values are kept and the input object is not mutated.
Key the memo cache on all arguments (JSON-serialized) instead of only the first argument, so the same first argument with a different second argument no longer returns the stale first answer.
loadAll maps ids to promises but returns the array without awaiting them, so callers receive Promise objects. Awaiting Promise.all makes loadAll resolve to the list of results.
Require a dot in the domain part of isEmail, so 'a@b' is rejected while addresses like 'a@b.co' and 'x.y@mail.example.org' still pass.
Rename fetchUser to getUser in its definition and export (apps/web/src/users.js) and at its import/call site (apps/web/src/greeting.js), matching the tests that already use getUser.

Make `get` refresh recency: on a hit, re-insert the key so it moves to the most-recently-used end of the Map, so a just-read entry is not the one evicted when the cache is full. A miss is left untouched.
Fix formatDuration so minutes and seconds are the remainders after removing hours/minutes, giving '1h 2m 5s' for 3725.
parseAge now validates its input and throws a RangeError containing 'invalid age' for non-numeric, negative or over-150 values (and empty input), while valid ages still return the number.
Fix subtotal so each line contributes price * qty instead of price once, making repeated items count correctly while discounts still apply to the corrected subtotal.
Make removeAt copy the input list before splicing so it returns a new list and leaves the caller's array unchanged.
